title: gallery-dl
description: Unchanged gallery-dl 1.32.15 Python engine: all 306 extractor modules bundled. Runtime support depends on site access and browser capabilities.

GALLERYDL_CONFIG.description: Upstream gallery-dl JSON configuration, including extractor/category settings, authentication and image/post ranges. Native subprocesses, browser database cookie readers and interactive OAuth are unavailable.

GALLERYDL_MAX_BYTES.description: Maximum supplemental response bytes; reaching the budget fails explicitly.

GALLERYDL_MAX_REQUESTS.description: Maximum supplemental HTTP requests; reaching the budget fails explicitly.
